name: Crusty DSL
summary: Business ADSL/SDSL ISP (MILNSBRIDGE IT VOICE & DATA PTY LIMITED t/as Crusty Bread Technology, ACN 099 539 009, ~2006); defunct.

events.details: Defunct. The real Crusty DSL shopfront was replaced by a domain-forward stub between 19 Aug and 26 Sep 2006; the 2006-2014 'presence' cited in the proposal was only that stub.

refs.label: Last full retail ISP homepage, 19 Aug 2006
Bare domain-forward stub by 26 Sep 2006 — retail site gone
Stub (later forwarding to Milnsbridge IT, same 1300 300 293) lingered to May 2014; it was never the retail site again
